name: Polar Mesh Exchange
blurb: Research traffic exchange above the Arctic Circle. Slow to answer subpoenas.
banner: Peering point for Arctic research networks.
Transit sessions are permitted under the member charter.

content.text:
POLAR MESH · MEMBER CHARTER

Polar Mesh is a traffic exchange for research networks north of the Arctic Circle.

Members agree to carry each other's traffic without inspecting it, and to answer the abuse desk within thirty days.

Requests from authorities outside Norway are answered in the order they arrive. The queue is long. We do not apologise for this.
